title: OptiMC
description: an optimization modpack, even more optimized than FO
body:
Optimc - Advanced Performance Optimization Modpack for Minecraft

This modpack is even more optimized than Fabulously Optimized ! : [Test beetwen OptiMC and Fabulously Optimized](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4466959d83408154331b65a8442ce7099215c9ab.jpeg)

Optimc is a modpack designed to deliver maximum performance optimization for Minecraft, aimed at improving the game's performance while maintaining a smooth and enjoyable gameplay experience. This modpack combines advanced mods to maximize resource management, reduce loading times, and enhance game stability.

Key Features:
Sodium: A powerful performance mod that reduces resource usage by optimizing graphical rendering, allowing for smoother gameplay even on lower-end systems.

Lithium and Starlight: These mods optimize entity management and lighting processing, improving game performance while maintaining excellent visual quality.

FerriteCore: Reduces memory usage by optimizing internal data storage, allowing Minecraft to run faster and more efficiently.

Dynamic FPS: Dynamically adjusts frames per second to provide stable performance based on system resources.

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine: A mod that allows more efficient chunk management, reducing lag when rendering the world.

FastQuit: Speeds up the game exit process, making the game quit faster without unnecessary delays.

Remove Reloading Screen: Removes the reload screen for a quicker transition between game sessions.

Zoomify: Adds a smooth and performant zoom feature without impacting performance, useful for exploring the world with more precision.

Iris Shaders: Enhances the game's graphics while maintaining excellent performance through lightweight and efficient shaders.

Clumps: Groups items that drop into a single stack to prevent system overload, especially when dealing with large amounts of drops.

Entity Culling and More Culling: Reduces graphical load by only rendering visible entities, easing the strain on system resources and improving performance.

Krypton: Optimizes network and packet management to reduce latency and improve multiplayer connection performance.

ModernFix and No Telemetry: Improve game stability and disable telemetry data collection, preserving privacy while optimizing performance.

FastChest: Speeds up the opening and closing of chests, reducing lag when interacting with containers.

Debugify: Allows for easier debugging and identification of performance bottlenecks for targeted optimization.

e4mc: Optimizes data and entity management, offering enhanced performance, particularly in survival or multiplayer modes.

OptiGUI: Enhances graphical user interface management, optimizing UI display for a smoother gameplay experience.

Entity Texture Features and Entity Model Features: Optimize entity texture and model handling, improving both performance and visual presentation.

With Optimc, every aspect of the game is optimized for a smooth and uninterrupted experience. Whether you're playing solo or on a multiplayer server, this modpack is designed to offer top-tier performance while keeping the visual experience enjoyable.
